port.description: HTTP listen port. Optional when using a Unix socket.

socket.description: Unix socket to listen on instead of a TCP port.

chmodSocket.description: File mode for the Unix socket.

trustProxy.description: Trusted reverse proxies or maximum trusted hop count.

redis.description: Default Redis connection and ioredis options.

redisForPubsub.description: Redis connection for pub/sub. Defaults to redis.

redisForJobQueue.description: Redis connection for job queues. Defaults to redis.

redisForTimelines.description: Redis connection for timelines. Defaults to redis.

redisForReactions.description: Redis connection for reactions. Defaults to redis.

sentryForBackend.description: Backend Sentry SDK options and profiling.

sentryForFrontend.description: Browser Sentry options. Set an integration to null to enable its defaults.

publishTarballInsteadOfProvideRepository.description: Publish a source tarball at build time.

setupPassword.description: Password required to create the initial administrator.

proxy.description: Proxy for outbound HTTP and HTTPS requests.

proxyBypassHosts.description: Hosts that bypass the HTTP proxy.

allowedPrivateNetworks.description: Private networks allowed for fetching attachments.

maxFileSize.description: Maximum upload or download size in bytes (default 262144000).

outgoingAddress.description: Local address used for outgoing requests.

outgoingAddressFamily.description: Deprecated IP family selection. Has no effect.

deliverJobConcurrency.description: Concurrent jobs per worker for the deliver queue.

inboxJobConcurrency.description: Concurrent jobs per worker for the inbox queue.

relationshipJobConcurrency.description: Concurrent jobs per worker for the relationship queue.

deliverJobPerSec.description: Maximum jobs per second for the deliver queue.

inboxJobPerSec.description: Maximum jobs per second for the inbox queue.

relationshipJobPerSec.description: Maximum jobs per second for the relationship queue.

deliverJobMaxAttempts.description: Maximum attempts per job for the deliver queue.

inboxJobMaxAttempts.description: Maximum attempts per job for the inbox queue.

cloudLogging.description: Google Cloud Logging project and service account configuration.

apFileBaseUrl.description: Override the ActivityPub file URL for object storage.

perChannelMaxNoteCacheCount.description: Deprecated channel note cache limit. Has no effect.

pidFile.description: Path for the master process ID file.

proxyRemoteFiles.description: Legacy setting used only when migrating the database.

signToActivityPubGet.description: Legacy setting used only when migrating the database.

disallowExternalApRedirect.description: Legacy setting used only when migrating the database.
